Specification: This module specifies a simple one-variable system intended to exercise TLC runtime introspection and mutable TLC-set state rather than model a distributed algorithm. The state variable x starts at 0 and is incremented by 1 on every Next step, while the specification checks values returned by TLCGet for configuration, statistics, revision metadata, and named TLCSet registers. The temporal behavior is defined by Init /\ [][Next]_x, and the file uses many ASSUME clauses to constrain expected TLC environment values such as BFS mode, no deadlock checking, string-valued metadata, and revision-related properties.
